outputs.explanation: Stacked bar/area chart showing median state-frequency composition (%) across Pol II ChIP-seq bins for thousands of promoters; this is a compositional/distributional summary across continuous bins, not a simple mean/median bar comparison amenable to point overlay, so individual data points are not needed.

Single-molecule stack display where each row already represents one individual DNA molecule; the accompanying sidebar percentages are summaries of this fully shown individual-level data, so the check does not apply.
Same type of stacked bar/area composition plot as panel A (mouse data); a compositional summary across bins, not a simple averaged bar chart requiring point overlay.
Single-molecule stack display (mouse Skp1 locus) where each row is an individual molecule; underlying individual data are already fully shown.
Box plot of PIC occupancy distributions; box plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as they already convey the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers).
Box plot of Pol II occupancy distributions; box plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement as they already convey the distribution (median, IQR, whiskers, outliers).
